NPC & station services · 15

These entries come from current-build bilingual dialogue and matching action scripts. Configuration values are not verified prices; hours, locations, current availability and destinations are not inferred from these nodes.

  • Electricity contract actions Game-build configuration

    Victor's dialogue lists a 1,000 C electricity-and-gas commissioning fee, end-of-day consumption billing and city purchase of surplus energy; the matching action deducts 1,000 C and supports later termination.

    Open related guide →

  • Water contract actions Game-build configuration

    Victor's dialogue lists a 500 C water commissioning fee, end-of-day consumption billing and city purchase of excess clean water; the matching action deducts 500 C and supports later termination.

    Open related guide →

  • Seed vendor catalogue and selling Game-build configuration

    The seed-vendor dialogue exposes separate actions for opening the goods catalogue and selling items from the player's inventory.

    Open related guide →

  • Bicycle rental terminal Game-build configuration

    The bilingual terminal dialogue lists a 1 C day rental and a 100 C destruction penalty. It checks stock, deducts 1 C, marks the assigned bicycle with a green light and says staff collect it at day's end.

    Open related guide →

  • Taxi rental terminal Game-build configuration

    The bilingual TaxiCo dialogue lists a 10 C day rental and a 100 C destruction penalty. It checks stock, deducts 10 C, marks the assigned taxi with a green light and reports when no taxi is available.

    Open related guide →

  • Vehicle repair dialogue Game-build configuration

    The country-mechanic path checks merchant availability, repairable vehicle content and sufficient funds before invoking a repair-all action; the displayed total is runtime-filled and no fixed amount is retained.

    Open related guide →

  • Animal infection treatment Game-build configuration

    Susan's path describes an animal infection needing antibiotics and rest, checks a runtime-filled total and sufficient funds, then invokes the shared repair-all action. No fixed treatment price is retained.

    Open related guide →

  • Subway travel actions Game-build configuration

    The subway dialogue exposes local travel, international travel and a return-to-ranch action. A matching local-ticket node checks and deducts 3 C; a separate current-build line describes the metro as open 24/7, but runtime operation and the destination list remain untested.

    Open related guide →

  • Remote portal travel action Game-build configuration

    Remote-portal dialogue describes entry to a shared space for meeting other Ranchers, includes respect/privacy/reporting guidance, and exposes options to return to the player's ranch or visit a friend. No fee, destination list or current availability is established.

    Open related guide →

  • Clothing and accessories catalogues Game-build configuration

    The clothing-shop dialogue opens separate clothing and accessories catalogues and also exposes an inventory selling action.

    Open related guide →

  • Additional land purchase Game-build configuration

    Victor's bilingual dialogue lists each additional plot at 300,000 C and directs the player to interact with the For Sale sign on the desired plot rather than return to City Hall.

    Open related guide →

  • Malcolm shop catalogue Game-build configuration

    A Malcolm-named conversation exposes a View shop items action after a merchant-availability check; the retained dialogue does not identify inventory or hours.

    Open related guide →

  • Meriam blueprint catalogue and selling Game-build configuration

    Meriam-named conversations expose a blueprint catalogue and an inventory-selling action; the dialogue alone does not establish the catalogue contents, prices or hours.

    Open related guide →

  • Country mechanic catalogue Game-build configuration

    Country-mechanic conversations expose a catalogue action behind a merchant-availability check. The retained nodes do not list its contents or prove current stock.

    Open related guide →

  • Angela shop catalogue Game-build configuration

    An Angela-named conversation exposes a View shop items action; the retained node does not list inventory, prices or hours.

    Open related guide →

Angela

The chicken seller tied to the coop mission, bird pickup and the correct coop climate equipment.

  • Current players identify Angela as the chicken seller used by the coop mission. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken coop mission · August 2026 animal support answers and community scan · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Purchased chickens appear in the fenced field behind her house rather than in the player's inventory; carry them or load them into a car boot. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken coop mission · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Official support context identifies Angela's coop/barn heater and AC as the functional versions; City Hall decoration units do not work for animal housing. Official

    Source: August 2026 animal support answers and community scan · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.x

Gigi

The NPC at the center of the current large-egg quest and its police-chase return route.

  • An official moderator reply identifies the two-egg hand-in as the end of the main questline for now; this does not catalogue optional or unrelated quests. Official

    Source: Steam thread: official reply on the current main quest endpoint · Build: null

  • The current quest route asks for two Large Eggs before the next handoff becomes available. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Real Eggs, Real Evidence quest route · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • After the egg handoff, Gigi follows the player through a police escape and must be returned to her home area to finish the documented route. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Real Eggs, Real Evidence quest route · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Multiple current players report no implemented follow-up quest after this route; treat it as the present story endpoint, not a hidden trigger with a known solution. Community-confirmed
